subject: PrivInfra ops kickoff and architecture review — next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@coremedtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: PrivInfra ops kickoff and architecture review — next steps

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the technical deep-dive scheduled: 

Summary from discovery:
- CoreMedTech will be evaluating a VPC/private deployment behind your existing firewall/VPN.
- Primary constraints: data residency in US-EAST, HSM integration for KMS, and strict audit logging requirements for R&D workloads.
- Key internal stakeholders: you (platform lead), Avery (security), and the network team.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute architecture review + ops kickoff with our solutions engineer to map topology and access needs. Suggested windows (all PT):
1) Tue Apr 13, 2027 — 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Apr 14, 2027 — 14:00–15:30

Draft agenda (we can adjust):
- 10 min introductions & goals
- 20 min infra constraints and current topology (CoreMedTech)
- 30 min Redwood private/VPC architecture and deployment pattern options
- 20 min integration points: KMS/HSM, audit logs, network egress controls
- 10 min next steps / owners / tentative timeline

Prep items we can send ahead: a 1-page ops runbook checklist (attached), a sample private-deploy baseline template, and a short pre-call compliance questionnaire if Avery wants to triage controls beforehand. Please let me know which time works and any other folks to include. 

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: ops-runbook-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@coremedtech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery McIntyre <avery.mcintyre@coremedtech.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T18:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivInfra ops kickoff and architecture review — next steps

Sofia — thanks for the clear recap and for pulling the items together.

We definitely want to move forward with the architecture review. A couple of notes before we lock a slot: 
- Our compliance lead Avery (cc'd) will need to review the questionnaire before the call; can you send that doc?
- We have a standing security review on Tue mornings, so Tue 10:00 PT conflicts.
- Wed 14:00 PT looks doable for us. Can we target Wed Apr 14, 14:00–15:30 PT?

Also, please plan to cover: HSM integration patterns (bring someone from infra who can speak to KMS options), and what minimum network ACLs we’ll need for a private deployment.

I’ll invite our network engineer (Carlos) once we lock time. Looking forward — Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Platform Lead | CoreMedTech
j.ellis@coremedtech.com | +1 (617) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T20:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivInfra ops kickoff and architecture review — next steps

Sofia — thanks for the ping and attaching the checklist. Quoting Jordan's note above: 

> Also, please plan to cover: HSM integration patterns (bring someone from infra who can speak to KMS options), and what minimum network ACLs we’ll need for a private deployment.

I can cover HSM/KMS patterns and the firewall/NAT requirements. I'll attach a baseline topology snippet and a short checklist of ACLs we typically request so we can run through it on Wed. Suggest we build a slide with the specific ports and certificate flows so the network team has something concrete to work from.

Attaching: redwood-privtemplate-v1.yaml (baseline topology)

--Ben

ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@coremedtech.com>

Date: 2027-04-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Apr 14 14:00 PT — PrivInfra architecture & ops kickoff (CoreMedTech)

Jordan/Avery — thanks for confirming. I’ve scheduled the 90-minute session for Wed Apr 14, 2027, 14:00–15:30 PT and sent a calendar invite (link in metadata). Meeting will include: Sofia (AE), Marissa (AM), Ben (SE), Jordan (Platform Lead), Avery (CISO), Carlos (Network).

Pre-call items: 
- Avery: I’ll send the precall compliance questionnaire now (attached as a Word doc) — if you want, flag anything that needs a pre-call writeup.
- Jordan/Carlos: please share the high-level topology diagram or VPN/access method (S3/FTPS/Direct Connect notes) before EOD Tue so Ben can prepare port-level slides.
- Redwood: Ben will bring HSM/KMS patterns and the sample ACL checklist.

Next actions (owners & timing):
- Sofia: send questionnaire + hubspot deal link (done) — leads to: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4782
- Jordan: share topology sketch — by 2027-04-13T17:00:00-07:00
- Ben: prepare slides + ACL list — by 2027-04-14T10:00:00-07:00

Deal context: this is scoped as a Private deployment with potential Dedicated fallback for higher throughput; preliminary estimate discussed in discovery is $Xk/month — subject to sizing. Deal ID: RWIN-2027-0048.

Looking forward — I’ll follow up with the invite & attachments.

Best,
Sofia
